Change the anatomy modestly but visibly: shorten BOTH arms from shoulder to wrist by approximately 8 percent, distributed across upper arm and forearm, so hands are a little higher on the thighs; preserve arm thickness, anatomical elbow position, natural compact hands and same straight relaxed A pose with arms separated from torso. Do not change leg lengths or shoulder width. One single character, front only, entire hair and both boots visible, both hands have five fingers.
